SELECT * FROM ( SELECT inner_q.*, ROWNUM rnum FROM ( SELECT game_code AS "game_code", game_title AS "game_title", game_desc AS "game_desc", game_contents AS "game_contents", game_developer AS "game_developer", game_publisher AS "game_publisher", publishing_date AS "publishing_date", NVL(game_price,0) AS "game_price", game_sale_price AS "game_salePrice", discount_per AS "discount_per", language_sup AS "language_sup", required_age AS "required_age", legal_notice AS "legal_notice", free_game AS "free_game", website AS "website", game_genre AS "game_genre", game_category AS "game_category", game_tag AS "game_tag", game_main_image AS "game_main_image", desc_images AS "desc_images", game_sys_req AS "game_sys_req", game_sys_req_r AS "game_sys_req_r", dlc_game AS "dlc_game", parent_game AS "parent_game", game_rating AS "game_rating" FROM gemdori_game_tbl WHERE 1=1
AND LOWER(game_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{dto.keyword}) || '%'
AND LOWER(game_genre) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{dto.genres}) || '%'
AND game_price = 0
AND game_price < 20000
AND game_price < 40000
AND game_price < 60000
AND game_price >= 60000
AND game_rating < 1
AND game_rating >= #{dto.rating}
AND parent_game IS NULL
AND parent_game IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY publishing_date DESC, game_code
ORDER BY publishing_date, game_code
ORDER BY game_rating DESC, game_code
ORDER BY game_price, game_code
ORDER BY game_price DESC, game_code
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(substr(game_code, 2))
) inner_q
WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rnum > #{startRow}

AND LOWER(game_title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND LOWER(game_genre) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{genres}) || '%'

ORDER BY game_price DESC, game_code
ORDER BY game_code
